name: Underhive Reputation
summary: Choose a reputation: feared, connected, slippery, or useful. Once per session, you can leverage that reputation to gain a minor favour, a rumour, a hiding place, illegal ammunition, a guide, or a black-market introduction, subject to GM approval.
